source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 510 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 510 was established by Ordinance No. 23578, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 24, 1998. Ordinance No. 23578 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 510 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of the Lyndon B. Johnson Freeway and Floyd Road. The size of PD 510 is approximately 14.431 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.104. DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development and landscape plan (Exhibit 510A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development and landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only use permitted in this PD is a transit passenger station or transfer center. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.106. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front, side, and rear yards. Front, side, and rear yards are as shown on the development and landscape plan.

(b) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 32,000 square feet.

(c) Height. Maximum structure height is 35 feet.

(d) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is five percent.

(e) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is one. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.108. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.109. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan, and installed in accordance with Article X. Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. Tree mitigation must be provided in accordance with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.110. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.111. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan. Traffic improvements on Floyd Road, as shown on the development and landscape plan, must be completed prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-510.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 510 is located on Zoning Map No. D-8. (Ord. Nos. 23578; 26042)
